name: io.github.sirkirby/unifi-drive-mcp
title: UniFi Drive MCP
description: Read UniFi NAS storage, disk health, shared drives and SMB/NFS file services via MCP.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_DRIVE_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Local UniFi OS username on the NAS

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_DRIVE_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Local UniFi OS password on the NAS

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_DRIVE_SSL_FINGERPRINT
environmentVariables.description: SHA-256 fingerprint pinning the NAS certificate (overrides UNIFI_DRIVE_VERIFY_SSL)
